common.startHereHint: Izikhokelo ezimfutshane ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, iFunda, ukuprinta ne-Wi-Fi.

home.heroSubtitle: Yonke into yeveki yakho yokuqala ikule ndawo. Awuqinisekanga ukuba uqala phi? Khangela, okanye vula iNkxaso. Ukubuza kuhlala kulungile.
home.checklistHint: Cofa umsebenzi ukuze uwuphawule, okanye vula uluhlu olupheleleyo. Akukho kungxama.

department.title: Evela kwisebe lakho
department.subtitle: Okulindelekileyo, imisebenzi neenkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano ezivela kwintloko yesebe lakho.

calendar.title: Ikhalenda yam
calendar.subtitle: Iintetho, i-orientation, iziganeko neenkqubo zakho kwimbonakalo yenyanga enye.

shuttles.title: Funda iishathile zakho
shuttles.subtitle: Amaxesha, into oyifunayo ukuze ukhwele, nokuba wenza ntoni xa udungekile.

societies.title: Imibutho
societies.subtitle: Ukholo, intsimi yakho yezifundo, okanye into eyahlukileyo kwaphela.

aiGuide.title: Ukusebenzisa i-AI kwizifundo zakho

arcade.title: IMadibaz Arcade
arcade.subtitle: Dlala umdlalo ongxamisekileyo uvule inyaniso ngeyunivesithi yakho.

emergency.title: Iinombolo zongxamiseko
emergency.subtitle: Ukucela uncedo kufuna isibindi. Nokuba kuyenzeka ntoni, uncedo lukwikholi enye kuphela, kwaye akukho namnye oya kukugweba.
emergency.dangerText: Yiya kwindawo ekhuselekileyo ukuba unako, uze ufowune. Akufuneki uchaze yonke into.
emergency.footer: Iinombolo zinokutshintsha. Ukuba enye ayisebenzi, byela umkhokeli okanye abaququzeleli ukuze ilungiswe.
emergency.homeText: Iinombolo zongxamiseko nezengcebiso. Ukufowuna kufuna isibindi, akukho mntu oya kukugweba.
emergency.tapHint: Cofa nayiphi na ikhadi ukufowuna. Ifowuni yakho iza kukubuza ukuqinisekisa ngaphambi kokudayela.

a11y.tabBar: Kwibha esezantsi kwe-app, khangela ithebhu ye-{{tab}}.

welcome.title: Wamkelekile kwi-Campus Companion
welcome.body: Iiveki zakho zokuqala eyunivesithi zinokubonakala zininzi, kwaye oko kuqhelekile ngokupheleleyo. Le app ibeka into oyifunayo kwindawo enye. Thatha uhambo lomzuzu omnye. Awunakwenza nto ephosakeleyo.
welcome.hint: Tsiba nangaliphi na ixesha. Ungayidlala kwakhona le nkqubo kwiProfayile yakho.

home.title: Isiseko sakho
home.body: IKhaya libonisa izaziso zamva nje, amaxesha e-shuttle esitishini sakho, kunye neencam ezikhawulezayo kuzo zonke ezinye izinto. Uphawu lwe-ENTSHA lubonisa ukuba isaziso sikhutshwe kutshanje kwaye awukasivuli.
home.hint: Rola ezantsi kwiKhaya ukufumana Ezemidlalo ne-gym, iinkqubo nemibuzo.

search.title: Fumana nantoni na ngokukhawuleza
search.body: Awuqinisekanga ukuba ujonge phi? Sebenzisa ibha yokukhangela. Ikhangela iimpendulo, iindawo, iiseshoni, abantu ofowunela bona neezikhokelo, zonke ngaxeshanye.

schedule.title: Yazi ukuba kufuneka ube phi, nini
schedule.body: Jonga iiseshoni zakho zoqhelaniso namaxesha neendawo zazo. Tshintshela kwiziganeko zekhampasi ukubona okwenzekayo ekhampasini.

map.title: Ungalahleki
map.body: Imephu yekhampasi ibonisa izakhiwo neendawo. Fumana indawo ufumane indlela yokuhamba ngeenyawo ukuya kuyo.

checklist.title: Phawula izinto ezibalulekileyo
checklist.body: Uluhlu lwabafundi abatsha lubonisa into ekufuneka uyilungiselele kwiiveki zakho zokuqala, njengokubhalisa ne-imeyile yakho yomfundi. Hamba ngesantya sakho uphawule njengoko ugqiba.

digital.title: Zilungiselele idijithali
digital.body: Izikhokelo ngenyathelo ngenyathelo zeFunda, i-Wi-Fi nokuprinta, kunye nezifundo ezimfutshane ngolawulo lweefayile, ukhuseleko kwi-intanethi, amagama okugqitha anamandla nokusebenzisa izixhobo ze-AI ngokuzibophelela.

tribe.title: Hlangana neQela lakho
tribe.body: IQela lakho yincoko nomkhokeli wakho nabanye abafundi bonyaka wokuqala. Ngaphambi kokuba ukhethe igama lencoko uya kuvuma ukuyigcina inembeko. Cofa Fumana amaqela ukujonga amaqela abakhokeli okanye uskeneye ikhowudi ye-QR.

help.title: Uncedo lusoloko luseduze
help.body: Awuqinisekanga ukuba ubuza bani? Vula iNkxaso, khetha into ofuna uncedo ngayo, kwaye i-app ikubonisa umntu okanye inkonzo efanelekileyo. Abafowunelwa babonisa abakhokeli nabacebisi onokuqhagamshelana nabo ngqo. Ngoncedo olungxamisekileyo, sebenzisa ikhadi ebomvu leeNombolo zongxamiseko eKhaya.

profile.title: Yenze eyakho
profile.body: KwiProfayile ungatshintshela phakathi kwesiNgesi, isiXhosa nesiAfrikansi, ukhethe imo ekhanyayo okanye emnyama, wenze nombhalo ube mkhulu. Ungayidlala kwakhona le nkqubo apho nanini na.

shuttle.chooseAbove: Khetha isitishini sakho ngasentla kwaye amaxesha akho aya kuvela apha.
shuttle.changeStop: Isitishini sakho yi-{{stop}}. Cofa ukuze usitshintshe.
shuttle.caption: Ikhampasi ye-{{campus}} · ishedyuli ye-{{year}}

support.title: Uncedo nenkxaso
support.subtitle: Ukucela uncedo kufuna isibindi, kwaye wonke umntu uyalufuna ngamanye amaxesha. Fumana umntu okanye inkonzo efanelekileyo, kwaye akukho namnye oya kukugweba.
support.unavailableText: Nceda uzame kwakhona xa unxibelelwano lubuyile.
support.noneText: Umququzeleli wakho uza kongeza iinkonzo zenkxaso apha. Okwangoku, sebenzisa iinombolo zongxamiseko okanye ubuze umkhokeli.
support.adviceLabel: Ingcebiso yezemfundo: jonga iinkqubo zeSikolo se-IT
support.adviceText: Jonga inkqubo yakho nokuba uthetha nabani.
